```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r setup-libraries, include=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)
library(multcomp)
library(multcompView)
library(colorspace)
library(scales)
library(patchwork)
library(PLS205)
library(car)
```


## **1. Load and Clean Data**
```{r load-data, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
biomass_data <- read.csv("biomass_data_manuscript.csv") %>%
mutate(
burn = factor(burn, levels = c("h", "ln", "lo", "n")),
sterilization = factor(sterilization),
drought = factor(drought, levels = c("full_water", "ABA", "primed")),
plant_id = factor(plant_id),
rack = factor(rack)
)
```


## **2. Model Selection: Mixed vs Fixed Effects**
```{r model-comparison}

# Test model with rack as a random effect
biomass_model_lmer <- lmer(dry_biomass ~ burn * sterilization * drought + (1 | rack), data = biomass_data)
biomass_model_lm <- lm(dry_biomass ~ burn * sterilization * drought, data = biomass_data)
anova(biomass_model_lmer, biomass_model_lm)
```


**We found that rack explained no significant variation in biomass (Chisq = 0, p = 1.000), so we used a fixed-effects model for final analyses.**

## **3. Check Model Parameters**
```{r}
# Additive model
m_add <- lm(
  dry_biomass ~ burn + sterilization + drought,
  data = biomass_data
)

# Burn × sterilization
m_bs <- lm(
  dry_biomass ~ burn * sterilization + drought,
  data = biomass_data
)

# Burn × drought
m_bd <- lm(
  dry_biomass ~ burn * drought + sterilization,
  data = biomass_data
)

# Sterilization × drought
m_sd <- lm(
  dry_biomass ~ sterilization * drought + burn,
  data = biomass_data
)

# All two-way interactions
m_2way <- lm(
  dry_biomass ~ (burn + sterilization + drought)^2,
  data = biomass_data
)

# Full factorial
m_full <- lm(
  dry_biomass ~ burn * sterilization * drought,
  data = biomass_data
)

AIC(
  m_add,
  m_bs,
  m_bd,
  m_sd,
  m_2way,
  m_full
)

# AICc model comparison
library(MuMIn)

model_selection <- model.sel(
  m_add,
  m_bs,
  m_bd,
  m_sd,
  m_2way,
  m_full,
  rank = "AICc"
)

print(model_selection)
```


## **4. Final Model and Summary**
```{r final-model}

# Full linear model without rack
biomass_model <- lm(dry_biomass ~ burn * sterilization + drought, data = biomass_data)
summary(biomass_model)


```

```{r diagnostics, echo=TRUE, eval=TRUE, include=FALSE}
# Check model assumptions
pls205_diagnostics(biomass_model)
```



## **5. ANOVA, Estimated Marginal Means and Group Comparisons**
```{r emmeans-results}

# ANOVA for selected biomass model
anova(biomass_model)

# EMMs for burn within each sterilization treatment
burn_by_ster_emm <- emmeans(
  biomass_model,
  ~ burn | sterilization
)

# Print EMMs
print(burn_by_ster_emm)

# Pairwise burn comparisons within each sterilization treatment
burn_by_ster_pairs <- pairs(
  burn_by_ster_emm,
  adjust = "bonferroni"
)

print(burn_by_ster_pairs)

# Compact letter display for burn treatments within sterilization treatment
burn_by_ster_cld <- cld(
  burn_by_ster_emm,
  adjust = "bonferroni",
  Letters = letters
)

print(burn_by_ster_cld)


# -----------------------------
# Unsterilized soils only
# -----------------------------

unsterilized_emm <- emmeans(
  biomass_model,
  ~ burn,
  at = list(sterilization = "unsterilized")
)

print(unsterilized_emm)

unsterilized_pairs <- pairs(
  unsterilized_emm,
  adjust = "bonferroni"
)

print(unsterilized_pairs)

unsterilized_cld <- cld(
  unsterilized_emm,
  adjust = "bonferroni",
  Letters = letters
)

print(unsterilized_cld)


# -----------------------------
# Sterilized soils only
# -----------------------------

sterilized_emm <- emmeans(
  biomass_model,
  ~ burn,
  at = list(sterilization = "sterilized")
)

print(sterilized_emm)

sterilized_pairs <- pairs(
  sterilized_emm,
  adjust = "bonferroni"
)

print(sterilized_pairs)

sterilized_cld <- cld(
  sterilized_emm,
  adjust = "bonferroni",
  Letters = letters
)

print(sterilized_cld)

```
```{r}
# EMMs for sterilization within each fire-history treatment
ster_by_burn_emm <- emmeans(
  biomass_model,
  ~ sterilization | burn
)

print(ster_by_burn_emm)

# Pairwise sterilization comparison within each fire history
ster_by_burn_pairs <- pairs(
  ster_by_burn_emm,
  adjust = "bonferroni"
)

print(ster_by_burn_pairs)
```


## **6. Figure: Unsterilized Soils**
```{r unsterilized-plot}

# Colorblind-friendly palette 
burn_colors_cb <- c(
  "High" = hcl(15, 75, 55),
  "Low (Initial)" = hcl(260, 60, 65),
  "Low (Advanced)" = hcl(75, 65, 75),
  "Suppressed" = hcl(330, 50, 70)
)

biomass_unsterilized <- biomass_data %>%
  filter(sterilization == "unsterilized") %>%
  mutate(
    burn = dplyr::recode(
      burn,
      h = "High",
      ln = "Low (Initial)",
      lo = "Low (Advanced)",
      n = "Suppressed"
    ),
    burn = factor(
      burn,
      levels = c(
        "High",
        "Low (Initial)",
        "Low (Advanced)",
        "Suppressed"
      )
    )
  )

# Prepare CLD labels from selected biomass model
unsterilized_cld_plot <- unsterilized_cld %>%
  mutate(
    burn = dplyr::recode(
      burn,
      h = "High",
      ln = "Low (Initial)",
      lo = "Low (Advanced)",
      n = "Suppressed"
    ),
    burn = factor(
      burn,
      levels = c(
        "High",
        "Low (Initial)",
        "Low (Advanced)",
        "Suppressed"
      )
    ),
    .group = trimws(.group)
  )

# Shared y-axis range
y_max <- max(biomass_data$dry_biomass, na.rm = TRUE)

y_limits <- c(
  0,
  y_max + 0.08
)

# Position CLD letters above the data
unsterilized_cld_plot$label_y <- y_max + 0.04

# Plot unsterilized soil biomass
final_burn_plot <- ggplot(
  biomass_unsterilized,
  aes(x = burn, y = dry_biomass, fill = burn)
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.6,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    alpha = 0.8,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.15,
    size = 1.5,
    shape = 21,
    color = "black",
    stroke = 0.3,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = unsterilized_cld_plot,
    aes(x = burn, y = label_y, label = .group),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 5
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = burn_colors_cb) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = y_limits) +
  labs(
    x = "Burn Severity",
    y = "Dry Biomass (g)",
    title = "Unsterilized Soils"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 50,
      hjust = 1,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      face = "bold",
      size = 16
    ),
    panel.border = element_rect(
      color = "black",
      fill = NA,
      linewidth = 1
    ),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

final_burn_plot
```

##**-------------------------------------**
##  **FINAL ANALYSIS USED IN MANUSCRIPT**
##**-------------------------------------**

```{r}
library(dplyr)       # needed for %>%
library(ggplot2)
library(emmeans)
library(multcomp)
library(multcompView)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Final biomass model: Fire History × Sterilization
# ------------------------------------------------------------

biomass_model <- lm(
  dry_biomass ~ burn * sterilization,
  data = biomass_data
)

anova(biomass_model)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Estimated marginal means
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# EMMs for all 8 Fire History × Sterilization combinations
biomass_emm <- emmeans(
  biomass_model,
  ~ burn * sterilization
)

print(biomass_emm)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# CLDs across all 8 Fire History × Sterilization combinations
# ------------------------------------------------------------

biomass_cld <- multcomp::cld(
  biomass_emm,
  adjust = "tukey",
  Letters = letters,
  sort = FALSE
) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(.group = trimws(.group))

print(biomass_cld)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Prepare raw data for plotting
# ------------------------------------------------------------

biomass_plot_data <- biomass_data %>%
  mutate(
    burn = dplyr::recode(
      burn,
      h  = "High",
      ln = "Low (Initial)",
      lo = "Low (Advanced)",
      n  = "Suppressed"
    ),
    burn = factor(
      burn,
      levels = c(
        "High",
        "Low (Initial)",
        "Low (Advanced)",
        "Suppressed"
      )
    ),

    sterilization = dplyr::recode(
      sterilization,
      sterilized   = "Sterilized",
      unsterilized = "Unsterilized"
    ),
    sterilization = factor(
      sterilization,
      levels = c("Unsterilized", "Sterilized")
    )
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Prepare CLD data for plotting
# ------------------------------------------------------------

biomass_cld_plot <- biomass_cld %>%
  mutate(
    burn = dplyr::recode(
      burn,
      h  = "High",
      ln = "Low (Initial)",
      lo = "Low (Advanced)",
      n  = "Suppressed"
    ),
    burn = factor(
      burn,
      levels = c(
        "High",
        "Low (Initial)",
        "Low (Advanced)",
        "Suppressed"
      )
    ),

    sterilization = dplyr::recode(
      sterilization,
      sterilized   = "Sterilized",
      unsterilized = "Unsterilized"
    ),
    sterilization = factor(
      sterilization,
      levels = c("Unsterilized", "Sterilized")
    )
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    biomass_plot_data %>%
      group_by(burn, sterilization) %>%
      summarise(
        group_max = max(dry_biomass, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      ),
    by = c("burn", "sterilization")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    label_y = group_max + 0.035
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Final Fire History × Sterilization plot
# ------------------------------------------------------------

dodge_width <- 0.75

biomass_plot <- ggplot(
  biomass_plot_data,
  aes(
    x = burn,
    y = dry_biomass,
    group = sterilization
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    aes(fill = sterilization),
    position = position_dodge(width = dodge_width),
    width = 0.65,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(
      fill = sterilization,
      shape = sterilization
    ),
    position = position_jitterdodge(
      jitter.width = 0.12,
      dodge.width = dodge_width
    ),
    size = 1.8,
    color = "black",
    stroke = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = biomass_cld_plot,
    aes(
      x = burn,
      y = label_y,
      label = .group,
      group = sterilization
    ),
    position = position_dodge(width = dodge_width),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 4
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Unsterilized" = "#4D8B57",
      "Sterilized"   = "grey70"
    ),
    name = "Soil Sterilization"
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      "Unsterilized" = 21,
      "Sterilized"   = 24
    ),
    name = "Soil Sterilization"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.15))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Fire History",
    y = "Dry Biomass (g)"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 50,
      hjust = 1,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.border = element_rect(
      color = "black",
      fill = NA,
      linewidth = 1
    ),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 20, 10, 10)
  )

biomass_plot
```

```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggnewscale)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Background colors for Fire History
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# Colorblind-friendly Fire History palette
burn_colors_cb <- c(
  "High" = hcl(15, 75, 55),
  "Low (Initial)" = hcl(260, 60, 65),
  "Low (Advanced)" = hcl(75, 65, 75),
  "Suppressed" = hcl(330, 50, 70)
)

fire_history_bg <- data.frame(
  burn = factor(
    c(
      "High",
      "Low (Initial)",
      "Low (Advanced)",
      "Suppressed"
    ),
    levels = c(
      "High",
      "Low (Initial)",
      "Low (Advanced)",
      "Suppressed"
    )
  ),
  xmin = c(0.5, 1.5, 2.5, 3.5),
  xmax = c(1.5, 2.5, 3.5, 4.5)
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Plot with Fire History background bands
# ------------------------------------------------------------

dodge_width <- 0.75

biomass_plot_bg <- ggplot() +

  # Fire History background bands
  geom_rect(
    data = fire_history_bg,
    aes(
      xmin = xmin,
      xmax = xmax,
      ymin = -Inf,
      ymax = Inf,
      fill = burn
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    alpha = 0.6,
    color = NA
  ) +

  # USE YOUR FIRE HISTORY COLORS FOR THE BACKGROUND
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = burn_colors_cb,
    guide = "none"
  ) +

  # Start a new fill scale for sterilization
  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +

  # Boxplots
  geom_boxplot(
    data = biomass_plot_data,
    aes(
      x = burn,
      y = dry_biomass,
      fill = sterilization,
      group = interaction(burn, sterilization)
    ),
    position = position_dodge(width = dodge_width),
    width = 0.65,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +

  # Individual observations
  geom_point(
    data = biomass_plot_data,
    aes(
      x = burn,
      y = dry_biomass,
      shape = sterilization,
      fill = sterilization,
      group = interaction(burn, sterilization)
    ),
    position = position_jitterdodge(
      jitter.width = 0.10,
      dodge.width = dodge_width
    ),
    size = 1.6,
    color = "black",
    alpha = 0.65,
    stroke = 0.3
  ) +

  # CLD letters
  geom_text(
    data = biomass_cld_plot,
    aes(
      x = burn,
      y = label_y,
      label = .group,
      group = sterilization
    ),
    position = position_dodge(width = dodge_width),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 5
  ) +

  # Gray boxplot fills
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Unsterilized" = "grey45",
      "Sterilized"   = "grey80"
    ),
    name = "Soil Sterilization"
  ) +

  # Point shapes
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      "Unsterilized" = 21,
      "Sterilized"   = 24
    ),
    name = "Soil Sterilization"
  ) +

  scale_x_discrete(
    expand = expansion(add = 0)
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.14))
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Fire History",
    y = "Dry Biomass (g)"
  ) +

  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +

  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1,
      face = "bold"
    ),

    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),

    axis.title.x = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      margin = margin(t = 14)
    ),

    panel.border = element_rect(
      color = "black",
      fill = NA,
      linewidth = 1
    ),

    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),

    plot.margin = margin(10, 20, 10, 10)
  )

biomass_plot_bg
```

##**Table for Supplemental
```{r}
library(broom)
library(dplyr)
library(flextable)
library(officer)

biomass_coef <- broom::tidy(biomass_model) %>%
  mutate(
    term = dplyr::recode(
      term,
      "(Intercept)" = "(Intercept)",
      "burnln" = "Low (Initial)",
      "burnlo" = "Low (Advanced)",
      "burnn" = "Suppressed",
      "sterilizationunsterilized" = "Unsterilized",
      "burnln:sterilizationunsterilized" =
        "Low (Initial) × Unsterilized",
      "burnlo:sterilizationunsterilized" =
        "Low (Advanced) × Unsterilized",
      "burnn:sterilizationunsterilized" =
        "Suppressed × Unsterilized"
    ),
    Significance = case_when(
      p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p.value < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p.value < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    )
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    Term = term,
    Estimate = estimate,
    `Std. Error` = std.error,
    `t value` = statistic,
    `p value` = p.value,
    Significance
  )

biomass_coef
```

```{r}
biomass_ft <- flextable(biomass_coef) %>%
  colformat_double(
    j = c("Estimate", "Std. Error", "t value"),
    digits = 4
  ) %>%
  colformat_double(
    j = "p value",
    digits = 4
  ) %>%
  autofit()

biomass_ft
```
